cautions: RefSeq may annotate only one haplotype; CAT and consensus use GenBank accessions, requiring explicit browser chromAlias mapping.

Consensus track longLabel specifies protein coding, so it is not a complete all-biotype annotation. CAT also annotates only the primary haplotype in these standard browser sources. Supplement curated MHC pseudogenes explicitly; an unannotated haplotype does not imply gene absence.
Presence of an annotated chromosome does not establish complete gene annotation. Probe counts count transcript models, not unique genes.
CAT/RefSeq exon-model labels and functionality can disagree with curated MHC manual annotations; preserve the manual MHC names/status as authoritative at the locus.

panel_c_boundary_gene_query.note: Gene-span union is5.109621Mb, not exact5.31Mb; gene labels alone do not resolve plotted flanks.
